title: Announcing Ndax Stake: Earn rewards
notes: First-party launch announcement explicitly stating that Ndax's first flexible crypto staking program was available starting 15 February 2022 with ETH, DOT and ADA.

title: Staking Policy
notes: Current first-party policy documenting opt-in staking, non-guaranteed rewards, slashing/on-chain risk, bonding/unbonding, redemption choices and administration fees.

title: Relationship Disclosure Document
notes: Current relationship disclosure documenting Ndax Staking Services, fixed reward-payment framework that may change, experienced third-party validator operators and custody arrangements.

title: User Agreement
notes: Current first-party User Agreement states users receive full rights, interests and title to Virtual Assets purchased on the platform and describes custody safeguards for assets left on-platform, including assets eligible for staking.

title: Risk Statement
notes: Current first-party staking risk statement documenting reliance on third-party validator-node operators, delegation/staking mechanics and slashing/loss risks.

title: VALR Launches Solana and Avalanche Staking
notes: First-party announcement explicitly stating that VALR officially launched crypto staking on 27 June 2023, initially with SOL and AVAX.

title: Terms of Service
notes: Current governing terms explicitly document on-chain staking, separate-account protocol facilitation, account-holder rights/title/ownership remaining unchanged, creditor exclusion, protocol-derived rewards, commissions, unstaking periods and slashing risk.

title: VALR
notes: Current first-party public product surface documenting continuing staking/yield functionality and current VALR operating identity.
